title: Onaron
description: A modpack created by Zac99LOL and Astrolux.
body:
A modpack made for Zac99LOL and Astrolux's server.

## Main Mods
- BetterEnd
  - Adds new terrain generation to the End dimension
- BetterNether
  - Adds new terrain generation to the Nether dimension
- Mythic Upgrades
  - Allows you to upgrade from Netherite to other materials, giving buffs
- Traveler's Backpack
  - Adds many Minecraft-styled backpacks
- Terralith
  - Heavily changes Minecraft world generation, using vanilla blocks
- YUNG's Mods
  - A collection of many mods, all changing main Minecraft structures, e.g.
    - Strongholds
    - Nether Fortresses
    - Mineshafts
    - Desert Temples
    - Jungle Temples
    - and more!
